propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures are invisible to callers consuming the plan-review gate's verdict JSON because failures are swallowed into abstain/degrade defaults with no in-verdict counter
The plan-review verdict's coverage object has no field for survived LLM failures; chunk_errors exists but is write-only and covers only Pass-1 chunks
All failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam at runner.py:573 which records to a JSONL spend log but not to any verdict-reachable structure

A new contextvars-based, run-scoped sink is needed to record failures at the runner seam and drain them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation-safety for clean runs
The step_failures sink must be a stdlib-only leaf module to avoid layering inversion when recording from the low runner layer
The drained coverage.llm_step_failures key must use _call_label verbatim and shape as {total: <int>, by_step: {<label>: <int>}} to match operator grep patterns for failed LLM calls
